message.content: Keysight serves technology innovators as a mission-critical design enablement partner, connecting design, emulation, and test solutions across the full lifecycle so that engineering teams can accelerate innovation and bring new technologies to market faster, with customers across AI infrastructure, communications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductor, and general electronics [D1]. In the third quarter ended July 31, 2026, revenue was $1.85 billion, of which the Communications Solutions Group contributed $1,345 million and the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group contributed $501 million [D1]. By end market, commercial communications revenue was $1,006 million, electronic industrial was $501 million, and aerospace, defense and government was $339 million [D1]. The company attributed the quarter's growth to 56 percent growth in commercial communications and 14 percent growth in aerospace, defense, and government within the Communications Solutions Group, and 21 percent growth in the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group across the semiconductor, general electronics, and automotive and energy markets [D1].
